name: storyloom
description: Single-user, local-first AI text adventure engine (AI Dungeon-style) — frontend game core, pluggable local inference backends.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.format: oxfmt src tests e2e playwright.config.ts scripts bench .github index.html vite.config.ts README.md package.json tsconfig.json lefthook.yml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests e2e playwright.config.ts scripts bench .github index.html vite.config.ts README.md package.json tsconfig.json lefthook.yml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.e2e:visual: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble sh -c "corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts"
scripts.e2e:update-screenshots: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble sh -c "corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots"
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --max-warnings=0 src tests e2e bench scripts
scripts.measure:renders: VITE_MEASURE_RENDERS=1 vite build --outDir dist-measure && MEASURE_RENDERS=1 playwright test e2e/renders.spec.ts --config playwright.measure.config.ts
